## Today's learning {#ss5-objective .gp-lesson}

### Lesson objective

Understand how a constant ratio connects a geometric sequence's recursive rule, general term and graph.

### Success criteria

I can recognise geometric sequences and use their rules to find unknown terms and explain their behaviour.

::: notes

Assume fluency with function notation, sequence indices and the arithmetic general term. Contrast repeated multiplication with repeated addition without repeating input/output instruction.

:::
